notes.title: v1.1.8 update
notes.content:
Thank you for downloading the DEMO version.

Improved performance for laptops with onboard graphics chips.
Comfortable battle effects.

The details are as follows.
We hope you will continue to enjoy the game.
We look forward to working with you in 2021.

[Add]
-Battle BGM randomization option
-Post-results conversation event+1
-Set letter sound effects for each character
-Added emotional skills "Anger Echo", "Fear Echo", and "Brave Echo".

[Improvement]
-Improved performance (if fps was 20-30 before, it may improve to 40-50+)
-Improved cut-in effects.
-If the decision button is pressed immediately after fleeing, the battle will not occur due to a hit decision.
-Removed the cooldown turn from the "応急処置" skill.
-Improved the "歯車の街" map effects.
-Changed the specifications of the "Attribute Ground" skill.
-Effects no longer linger after the battle.
-Prevented the use of attribute skills by carrying over a battle
-The map effect will be initialized after using the Attribute Field Skill.
Fear and Echo effect for "デコイガード".
Anger Echo effect on "ヴァルキュリア".

[Fixed]
In the "心音の森", the message "強敵の出現" occurs in a specific map.
When accepting a "公正な取引", a double judgment will be made.
The damage of ”雷鳴の一振り” was incorrectly determined.

There is also a feedback / bug report thread.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1184850/discussions/0/2971776551512979286/
There is also the author Twitter, please let us know in a way that is convenient for you.
@rpgmaker_kuro

If you like it, please consider adding it to your wishlist.
We'll keep working on the full release!
Thank you for your patience.
